2608.02276.title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
2608.02276.paper_summary: Agents built around large language models continually accumulate interaction trajectories during deployment, yet their behavior typically remains fixed. Beyond updating model weights, these trajectories can improve the agent harness that constructs context, mediates tools, validates actions, and recovers execution. We introduce Harness-R1, the first method, to our knowledge, that makes failure-conditioned, lifecycle-wide editing of an existing executable runtime a learned capability. It post-trains a dedicated harness engineer with online reinforcement learning so that its edits are optimized for the realized task success they produce, rather than proposed by a fixed editor. A separate 9B engineer converts batches of target-agent failures into validated executable patches; fresh same-batch reruns of the frozen target provide outcome rewards, so training updates only the engineer. Cold-start supervised fine-tuning initializes this editing policy, which is then trained online with group-relative policy optimization. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench, Harness-R1 raises vanilla Qwen3.5-9B success from 44.3% to 53.6% (+9.3 percentage points). After direct target-agent fine-tuning, a target-specific engineer raises the average further from 59.2% to 64.2% (+5.0 points); because these gains hold both before and after fine-tuning the target, Harness-R1 points toward co-evolving the harness engineer and the target agent.
2608.02276.paper_summary_zh: 代理商圍繞大型語言模型建立，持續在部署期間累積互動軌跡，但它們的行為通常保持固定。除了更新模型權重外，這些軌跡可以改善構建上下文、調解工具、驗證行動和恢復執行的代理商工具。我們介紹了Harness-R1，據我們所知，這是第一種使得失敗條件下的全生命周期編輯現有可執行運行時成為學習能力的方法。它使用在線增強學習對專門的工具工程師進行後訓練，以便其編輯針對所產生的實現任務成功進行優化，而不是由固定編輯器提出。另一個9B工程師將目標代理的失敗批次轉換為經過驗證的可執行補丁；新鮮的同批次重跑凍結目標提供結果獎勵，因此訓練僅更新工程師。冷啟動的監督微調初始化這一編輯策略，然後通過群體相對策略優化進行在線訓練。在WebShop、ALFWorld和DBBench中，Harness-R1將原始的Qwen3.5-9B的成功率從44.3%提高到53.6%（+9.3個百分點）。在對目標代理進行直接微調後，針對特定目標的工程師將平均成功率進一步提高至59.2%至64.2%（+5.0個百分點）；因為這些增益在微調目標之前和之後都保持不變，Harness-R1指向工具工程師和目標代理的共同演化。
